name: Aura Salla - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Displaced Workers following an application from Finland – EGF/2026/004 FI/Etelä-Suomi and Helsinki-Uusimaa paper
part_text:
The European Parliament approves giving Finland 1,102,560 euros from the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund. The money helps 351 workers who lost jobs in paper manufacturing in Etelä-Suomi and Helsinki-Uusimaa. The fund pays 60 percent of a 1,837,600 euro support package. The package includes job-search training, career coaching, vocational training, help starting a business, pay subsidies and a mobility allowance. Parliament also calls for tailored help for older workers and workers with lower education, and for a thorough evaluation afterwards.

- Finland receives 1,102,560 euros to support 351 former paper industry workers.
- The workers get training, coaching, subsidies and business start-up help.
- Finland runs the measures; Parliament asks for a final evaluation.
